text: The Fed is now signaling possible rate hikes in 2026 while GDP growth slowed to just 1.5% last quarter and payrolls turned negative — this stagflationary mix (slowing growth plus sticky 3.3% inflation) means the economy is losing momentum while borrowing costs won't be coming down anytime soon, so favor quality holdings and keep cash ready.
Raise your stop on NSC from $311.84 to $328.42 — this locks in more of your gains and protects you if the slowing economy starts weighing on railroad shipping volumes.

Consider adding to META — at just 16.5x earnings with 22% revenue growth and strong free cash flow, it's a rare case of a big tech name that's both growing fast and priced reasonably, which gives you a cushion even if the economy softens.

Consider adding to UNH — as a healthcare giant trading at 17.5x earnings with nearly 12% revenue growth and best-in-class free cash flow, it's a defensive grower that should hold up well in a slowing economy with sticky inflation.
